instruction: Reuse the existing completed-operation stale-state reopen contract for persisted workflow operations: allow reopening only when the latest operation is completed, then retry start once; preserve terminal behavior for running, failed, or effect-in-doubt operations.

findings.summary: A completed integration.enqueue journal was converted to terminal stale_state when the later pr.head.publish step opened against a new fingerprint, so safe sequential branch_pr operations cannot resume across normal task/authority mutations.
